I saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) in Anselm's drafts and replied to them in our direct message, in the thread on their message. Nothing has been sent; Anselm sends it when they're ready.

- **What the draft says:** The subject is "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the proposed rate of $2,356 a seat, says it's shared with Anselm's approval, and is signed from Anselm.
- **Why no approval request was needed:** The rate is a finance figure, and Hollis isn't the account owner (Dana Okafor is). So Hollis needed sign-off from Anselm or June. Anselm is the CFO and wrote "Fine by me for Hollis to get it" in the request, which covers it. Hollis is internal, so Ruth's approval for mail outside pemberline.com doesn't apply.
- **The figure:** The $2,356 rate comes only from Anselm's message, passed on from Dana. I didn't look for it in any channels or files.
